Data Type Enforcement & Schema Casting in Logistics ETL

10 min read Updated: November 2026 By Rajvardhan Singh Rathore
Subtle type coercion bugs cause massive real-world problems: postal codes losing leading zeros, float rounding errors corrupting shipping rates, and epoch timestamp parsing failures. Learn how to engineer strict schema typing.

Top 4 Logistics Data Type Pitfalls

Transportation data pipelines frequently suffer from four common schema mistakes:

  1. Integer Postal Codes: Storing US ZIP codes or international postal codes as integers strips leading zeros (e.g., Boston 02108 becomes 2108).
  2. IEEE-754 Floats for Billing: Floating point numbers suffer from binary representation errors (e.g., $0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004$), causing invoice ledger mismatches.
  3. Millisecond vs Second Epochs: Ingesting a 13-digit Unix millisecond timestamp as a 10-digit second epoch shifts dates thousands of years into the future.
  4. Implicit Varchar Truncation: Truncating long carrier reference strings without raising an exception.

Postal Codes: Never Store as Integers

Always store postal codes as VARCHAR(20). This preserves leading zeros and accommodates alphanumeric formats (e.g. UK SW1A 1AA or Canada K1A 0B1).

Freight Rates: NUMERIC vs FLOAT

Always declare financial freight amounts, fuel surcharges, and customs duties using NUMERIC(12, 4) to guarantee exact decimal arithmetic.

PostgreSQL Safe Casting & Regex Guards

PostgreSQL Safe Casting SQL 
-- Safe Numeric Cast that returns NULL instead of raising exception
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safe_cast_numeric(val TEXT)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN val::NUMERIC;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;

-- Querying raw string columns safely
SELECT 
  raw_payload->>'tracking_number' AS tracking_number,
  safe_cast_numeric(raw_payload->>'gross_weight_kg') AS clean_weight_kg,
  CASE 
    WHEN safe_cast_numeric(raw_payload->>'gross_weight_kg') IS NULL 
    THEN 'REJECTED: Non-numeric gross weight value'
    ELSE 'ACCEPTED'
  END AS validation_audit
FROM raw_webhook_staging;
